definitions.strict_anchor: One grounded displayed source span, same canonical source_id and source_field, contains the original gold start/end and exact quote. Separate spans are not joined.
definitions.strict_fact: Every support anchor of this fact meets strict_anchor. Unit is a fact, not a source span or anchor.
definitions.same_source_mirror_fact: Every support meets strict_anchor or its exact quote occurs in a grounded displayed span from a different field of the SAME source_id. This is the R18 secondary source-chain diagnostic definition.
definitions.catalog_aliases: Rxxxx citation refs and Sxx source aliases are presentation identifiers. Both methods use canonical source_id after validation. Alias numbering is not the cause of the 13-fact difference.
definitions.grounding: Held d935 reader_citation_catalog validates every displayed quote against its own original source field and role. Cross-field diagnostic matching does not change canonical fields or create a new catalog witness.
